name: Djeni
bio: I’m Djeni and I’m delighted to welcome you to Perfect London Massage. I’m 30 years old and come from the beautiful state of Paraná in southern Brazil, close to the borders of Argentina and Paraguay. Growing up in such a diverse and vibrant region taught me to appreciate different cultures, connect easily with people, and always greet life with a smile. I completed my first course in Aesthetics and Massage. From that moment, I knew I had found something I genuinely loved. Wanting to deepen my understanding of the human body, I went on to earn a degree in Sports Science, where I also developed knowledge of movement, recovery, and physical wellbeing. Every client is different, and every massage should be too. I take the time to understand what your body needs, tailoring each treatment to help you relax, recharge, and leave feeling refreshed from head to toe. Outside of work, you’ll usually find me at the gym, keeping active, or exploring new places whenever I have the opportunity. I love learning new things and am always looking for ways to improve my skills, because I believe there’s always something new to discover when you’re passionate about what you do. I’m a positive, caring, and easy-going person, and I know that feeling comfortable with your therapist is just as important as the massage itself. My warm smile and friendly nature help clients feel at ease from the moment we meet, allowing you to relax and enjoy your treatment with complete confidence.

With a wealth of training and professional experience under her belt, Lara's classic massages are designed to alleviate pain and stress, leaving you feeling rejuvenated and restored. Step into a world of tranquility as Lara combines deep pressure movements, soothing strokes, and myofascial release techniques to create a bespoke treatment tailored to your needs. Each session with Lara promises a truly unique and special experience, where your comfort and well-being take center stage. Join the ranks of satisfied clients who rave about Lara's exceptional skills and therapeutic touch. Embark on a journey towards holistic wellness and blissful relaxation as you allow Lara to guide you towards a state of profound healing and rejuvenation. Book your appointment today and discover the magic of Lara's transformative massages that have earned her a glowing reputation as a highly recommended therapist. Classic, Relaxing, Swedish, Deep Tissue & Aromatherapy Massage, Sports, Myofascial

name: Adeany
bio: Adeany adds a touch of warmth and passion to every massage. Her techniques are designed not only to relax your body but also to uplift your spirit, leaving you with a sense of bliss and tranquillity. Whether you’re seeking relief from everyday stress or simply want to treat yourself and have a nice relaxing time, She is here to provide you with an unforgettable experience! Let the healing power of her touch transport you to a state of pure relaxation. She is qualified for medium pressure with a beautiful rhythm and will adapt your massage to fit your needs. Relaxing, Classic, Swedish & Aromatherapy Massage
